findings.current: He twisted aside on instinct, but blood and terrible pain spread along the path of the strike.
findings.defect: The Korean says the blood and pain spread along his body as he twisted aside on instinct. “Along the path of the strike” adds a trajectory the source does not establish.
findings.rationale: 몸뚱어리를 따라 refers to the twisted body, not the path of the strike.
findings.replacement: He twisted aside on instinct, but blood and terrible pain spread through him.

summary: The assembled chapter is faithful overall, with one minor physical-detail shift.
